4478.title: ACP discovery changes persisted model preference
4478.rootCauseOneLine: ACP discovery selects each model without restoring the initial preference; a state-persisting synthetic agent retains the final probe.
4478.proposedFix: Prefer side-effect-free discovery or restore original model and dependent preferences with error/timeout handling.
4478.caveats: Synthetic persisted model reproduced in two clean same-agent runs; real Prime Agent and thinking-level persistence unverified.
